class.name: JRPGTransferPlayerCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: moves the player to another place, on this map or another.
class.description: Moves the player to cell ([member x], [member y]) of map [member map_id], or to the map and cell variables [member map_variable], [member x_variable] and [member y_variable] hold when [member from_variables], facing [member direction], through [member fade]. It waits until the transfer has finished, fade in included; the event's next commands run on the new map. A transfer the host refuses (a map the game lacks, a cell outside it) is warned about and the event goes on. It goes through the event host ([JRPGEventHost]); without one nothing happens, with a warning. Authority: server.

members.member: The direction the player faces on arrival: [code]-1[/code] keeps the facing; 0 up, 1 right, 2 down, 3 left.
How the screen changes: [constant JRPGEventHost.FADE_BLACK], [constant JRPGEventHost.FADE_WHITE] or [constant JRPGEventHost.FADE_NONE].
The map and cell are read from variables.
The variable holding the destination map's ID.
The variable holding the destination cell's column.
The variable holding the destination cell's row.
